title: Creamy Sweet Potato Soup
description: A comforting and creamy soup made with roasted sweet potatoes and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Toss the sweet potatoes with a tablespoon of oil and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, sauté the onion and garlic over medium heat until softened.
Add the roasted sweet potatoes, coconut milk, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Stir in the sour cream or coconut cream and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs or a sprinkle of paprika.
